svg.title: PipelinePilot status flow
svg.desc: Opportunity statuses and views after ADR-012 and ADR-013. Quick-fit opportunities are promoted into Analyzing and worked in the Application Tracker until JFA decides Passed or Applied. Agency outreach lives in a Recruiter Tracker, to be designed in ADR-014, and becomes an Applied opportunity when the recruiter submits you to the client. The first follow-up 14 or more days after applying moves Applied to Pursuing, worked in the Pursuit Tracker, with no way back to Applied. Applied, Pursuing and Interviewing close out to Rejected, Ghosted or Closed. Final statuses are never reopened.
svg.text: Valid statuses and views after ADR-012 and ADR-013. Status only moves down or across.
Closing out, from Applied, Pursuing, or Interviewing
• Status only moves down or across this chart. Nothing moves back up.
• Passed, Offer, Rejected, Ghosted and Closed are final. They are never reopened.
• In Review and Capturing are retired by ADR-013 (Capturing merges into Analyzing).
• A reposted role, or the employer coming back after a final status, is a new opportunity.
• New is set only by rebuild-index, for a folder on disk with no record. Move it to Analyzing by hand.
Italic line in a box = the view where that status is worked.
